items.title: Add renderChecklistDerivedLedger renderer
items.context: In packages/main/src/core/milestone-status.ts, add an exported pure function that groups a story's checklist items by status (done / in_progress / pending) under a distinct 'Checklist-derived ledger (no milestone ledger set) - <id>' header, plus a Phase line and a Progress summary. Must not reuse the 'Milestone Status - <id>' header. Export CHECKLIST_DERIVED_HEADER for dedup.

happy.desc: renderChecklistDerivedLedger groups items into done/in_progress/pending under the distinct "Checklist-derived ledger (no milestone ledger set) - <id>" header with Phase + Progress lines

edge.desc: empty checklist renders a stub with "(no checklist items)" and a 0/0/0 progress line, never throws

adversarial.desc: output must NOT contain the "Milestone Status -" header, so it cannot be mistaken for a real milestone table

verificationEvidence.note: Unit test asserts the derived-ledger header, Phase/Progress lines and the ✅/⏳/⬜ grouping (derivedText block).
emptyDerived assertions cover the empty-checklist stub (no checklist items) + 0/0/0 progress without throwing.
assert.doesNotMatch(derivedText, /Milestone Status -/) proves the derived ledger never fabricates a milestone table.

items.title: Rework appendMilestoneStatusAfterMutation for always-show and visible failure
items.context: In packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts, when no milestone ledger exists render the checklist-derived ledger instead of returning bare output; keep the real milestone table when a ledger exists and keep the DONE worktree-cleanup main-root fallback; replace the silent stderr catch branches with a visible stdout block; exit code stays 0; --json still suppresses.

happy.desc: a no-ledger story running checklist_update appends the checklist-derived ledger to stdout instead of showing nothing

edge.desc: a story with a real milestone ledger still shows the Milestone Status table; the DONE worktree-cleanup main-root fallback still resolves the real ledger

adversarial.desc: --json output stays pure JSON (no table appended); a render failure surfaces a visible "⚠ Milestone Ledger: render FAILED" block on stdout while exit code stays 0

verificationEvidence.note: The no-ledger CLI checklist_update path now emits the Checklist-derived ledger header + the mutated item row on stdout.
The real-ledger CLI append test and the DONE main-root fallback test still assert the Milestone Status table (realRender path preserved).
The --json purity assertion stays green (no table appended); visibleFailure keeps exit 0 (mutation already committed).

items.title: Update and extend milestone-status tests
items.context: In packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs, invert the no-ledger assertion (around 302-306) to require the checklist-derived ledger and forbid the Milestone Status header; add unit coverage for renderChecklistDerivedLedger including the empty-checklist stub; keep the real-ledger and --json regressions green.

happy.desc: the inverted no-ledger CLI assertion passes: stdout contains the checklist-derived ledger header and the mutated item row, and does not contain "Milestone Status - <id>"

edge.desc: a direct unit test of renderChecklistDerivedLedger covers the three-status grouping and the empty-checklist stub

adversarial.desc: pre-existing real-ledger append and --json purity assertions remain green (no regression)

verificationEvidence.note: The inverted no-ledger assertion now requires the derived-ledger header and forbids Milestone Status - <id>, and passes.
New renderChecklistDerivedLedger unit test covers three-status grouping and the empty stub.
Pre-existing real-ledger append and --json purity assertions remain green — verified in the same suite run (ok milestone-status).
